newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Group requests share suspension.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Group requests share suspension.

text.p: Malaysia's Berjaya Group Bhd said in a statement that it was requesting the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange to suspend trading of its shares with effect from 0930 local time (0130 GMT) on Tuesday.
The company said it was requesting the suspension "pending an announcement."
Company officials could not be contacted for comment.

Berjaya Group announced on Monday that it sold a 19 percent stake in Berjaya Industrial Bhd for 337.29 million ringgit. On December 3 Berjaya Group had said it was divesting a 32 percent stake in the same company.
